name: Jarvis
summary: Jarvis is a local AI assistant for macOS, Windows and Linux. Talk naturally, chat by text, remember past conversations and dictate into other apps, with models and memory on hardware you control.

pages.title: Jarvis: a private local AI assistant for your desktop
pages.description: Meet Jarvis, a private local AI assistant with voice and text chat, personal memory, dictation and MCP tools for macOS, Windows and Linux.

pages.title: Get started with Jarvis: download and local model setup
pages.description: Download Jarvis for macOS, Windows or Linux, choose local speech and chat models, and start talking or typing. No subscription is required.

pages.title: Jarvis privacy, offline use and licensing questions
pages.description: Understand where Jarvis stores memory, which features work offline, when tools use the network, and what its non-commercial licence permits.
